'''Whumparrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who was rescued from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camp by an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] unit. After that, he decided to join the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. His first assignments were fire-support. He used his strength to transport heavy equipment, and survived many intense [[lightfight]]s before he was promoted to [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], when he joined [[Team 19]]. Whumparrin taught the rest of the team to speak [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]], thereby eliminating a lot of communication problems. He became the team's heavy weapons specialist and worked on administrative duties with the droid [[C-7NO]].<ref name="ROE" />
